query: PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>             PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>             PREFIX euvoc: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/euvoc#>             PREFIX authority: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/authority/>                     SELECT DISTINCT ?org ?org_code ?org_desc ?treaty ?startDate ?endDate ?replaces                     where {{?org_code skos:prefLabel ?org_desc;                                       authority:authority-code ?org;                                       euvoc:startDate ?startDate.                             OPTIONAL {                             ?org_code euvoc:endDate ?endDate.                             }                             OPTIONAL{                             ?org_code euvoc:legallyBasedOnTreaty ?treaty_code.                             ?treaty_code skos:prefLabel ?treaty.                             FILTER(langMatches(lang(?treaty), "en")).                             }                             OPTIONAL{                             ?org_code dcterms:replaces ?replaces.                             }                             }                             filter(?org_code=<PARAMETER>).                            FILTER(langMatches(lang(?org_desc), "en")).                            }

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>      PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>     PREFIX org: <http://www.w3.org/ns/org#>             SELECT DISTINCT ?s ?article #?label             where {{?s <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/P1186> 'PARAMETER2'.                     ?article schema:about ?s .                     ?article schema:inLanguage "en" .                     ?article schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> .                     }                     }

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> PREFIX org: <http://www.w3.org/ns/org#> PREFIX euvoc: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/euvoc#> PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/> PREFIX resource: <http://publications.europa.eu/resource/> SELECT DISTINCT ?membership ?membership_order ?membership_positionStatus ?person ?person_image   where {{?membership_uri org:organization ?directoryOrg_uri;                         euvoc:order ?membership_order;                         euvoc:positionComplement ?membership;                         euvoc:positionStatus ?membership_positionStatusUri.     ?directoryOrg_uri skos:prefLabel ?directoryOrg.     ?membership_positionStatusUri skos:prefLabel ?membership_positionStatus.     ?person_uri org:hasMembership ?membership_uri;                 foaf:name ?person. OPTIONAL{     ?person_uri foaf:img ?person_image.     BIND (STRBEFORE(STRAFTER( STR(?person_image), "https://www.europarl.europa.eu/mepphoto/" ), ".jpg" ) AS ?person_id)     }     }  filter(?directoryOrg_uri=<PARAMETER>). FILTER(langMatches(lang(?membership), "en")). FILTER(langMatches(lang(?membership_positionStatus), "en")). FILTER(langMatches(lang(?directoryOrg), "en")). }ORDER BY ?membership_order ?person
